verdict.rationale: Superpowers skills auto-trigger on contextual events (session start, failed fix attempts, git conflicts, worktree issues) and users can author new skills that encode conditional trigger/action rules, but this is a semantic skill-matching system rather than a general-purpose 'if event X then action Y' rule engine that AI-native users can freely define for arbitrary events. missing for 10: an explicit user-facing rule/trigger definition interface (vs. embedding logic in skill docs), support for arbitrary custom events beyond built-in dev workflow triggers, and independent confirmation that user-authored triggers reliably fire.
